annotations.title: List merchants you can act as

description:
FALLBACK merchant list for clients WITHOUT UI support.

Do NOT use this to choose or switch merchants when a UI is available —
call `jobmojito_configuration` instead (it renders an interactive picker),
and do not hand-format a merchant list as text. Use this tool only when the
client cannot render MCP App UI. Returns the user's own account plus any
sub-merchants; after a pick, pass `merchant_id=<chosen id>` on subsequent
calls (OMIT for the own account).

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on sub-merchant name.
